channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Could Iran war trigger a hunger crisis?
item.description: The UN warns disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz could drive up food and fertiliser costs, and worsen global hunger.

item.title: Japanese snacks go black-and-white: Why Iran war is driving up ink prices
item.description: Calbee says it would temporarily use only black and white colours on 14 of its products due to a lack of printing ink.

item.title: Iran war day 76: Vance says progress made in talks; Israel pounds Lebanon
item.description: US Vice President Vance says progress is being made in talks with Iran as President Trump begins his trip to China.

item.title: Trump in China for talks with Xi Jinping
item.description: Trump visits Beijing for high-stakes summit with Xi as Iran, trade and Taiwan strain US-China ties.

item.title: Iran’s US-bound World Cup squad given public sendoff in Tehran
item.description: Thousands of people cheered Team Melli as Iran's World Cup kit was unveiled before the team's training camp in Turkiye.

item.title: Kyiv building collapses after Russian strike, reportedly trapping residents
item.description: Russia attacked the Ukrainian capital Kyiv with drones and missiles, damaging several buildings.

item.title: Iran war: Why the BRICS foreign ministers meeting in India matters
item.description: The foreign ministers meeting is taking place before the 2026 BRICS summit in India in September.

item.title: Trade, Iran and Taiwan on the agenda as Trump arrives in China for high-stakes talks with Xi
item.description: The US president says his first request to Xi would be to "open up" China, while Beijing is expected to press Trump on the status of Taiwan.

item.title: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon kill 22 people, health ministry says
item.description: Eight children are among those reported dead after a series of air strikes hit the south of Beirut.

item.title: Lebanon says two paramedics among 13 killed in Israeli strikes
item.description: Lebanon's health ministry says the paramedics were carrying out a rescue mission in Nabatieh in response to an earlier attack that killed one person.
